mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.2% within the last month signals a tightening labor market, which increases consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate sales (HOUST) by more than 5% over the last two months signals a strong demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the last month signals a contraction in supply, which leads to increased prices and reduced corporate profits, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment (CPIAUCSL) below 2% for three consecutive months signals a stable economic environment, which supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when CPIAUCSL is below 2% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the last month, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2%, signals a strong labor market and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real disposable personal income (RSAFS) by more than 1% over the last two months signals increased consumer spending, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 0.5% over the last quarter signals an economic slowdown, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when the trigger condition is met.
